then.text: The same cheese with two names. Fine. Fine! But mine squeaks louder. Kopiaste: come and join us, sit, eat.
You've had mine. Now go and have his, so you can tell him how much better mine is.
Ah, the judge! Taste. Sheep's and goat's milk, warmed, curdled, the curds cooked in the hot whey and folded over with dried mint, like my mother did.
Grill it, and it doesn't melt. It squeaks on your teeth. That's how you know it's honest.

else.text: Kaliméra! Good morning. Coffee? A Cypriot coffee: you say 'métrios' for medium sweet, 'skétos' for none. The grounds stay in the cup. Don't drink those.
Hüseyin across the square calls it Turkish coffee. It's the same pot, the same coffee, the same argument for fifty years.

pyl_tavli.text: Tavli, backgammon. Hüseyin's lot call it tavla. We play each other on Thursdays. Nobody has ever admitted to losing.
